item.description: Learn about one of our nominees for Kern County's February spotlight, showcasing Rick Shaw with the Skye's The Limit.

item.title: Where Highway 46 Leads When You Stop Rushing
item.description: Explore where Highway 46 leads you when you stop rushing.
